items.question: How long did Cappie Pondexter play in the WNBA?
items.answer: Cappie Pondexter played 13 WNBA seasons, from 2006 to 2018.

items.question: What are Cappie Pondexter's stats?
items.answer: Cappie Pondexter's latest season is listed by team, not as one combined average.

items.question: Which WNBA teams has Cappie Pondexter played for?
items.answer: Cappie Pondexter has played for the Phoenix Mercury, New York Liberty, Chicago Sky, Los Angeles Sparks and Indiana Fever.

items.question: Did Cappie Pondexter win a WNBA championship?
items.answer: Yes. Cappie Pondexter won WNBA titles with the Phoenix Mercury in 2007 and 2009 and was Finals MVP in 2007. She was a seven-time WNBA All-Star.

items.question: Where did Cappie Pondexter play college basketball?
items.answer: Cappie Pondexter played at Rutgers. The Phoenix Mercury drafted her second overall in 2006.

items.question: Is Cappie Pondexter in the Hall of Fame?
items.answer: Yes. Cappie Pondexter was inducted into the Women's Basketball Hall of Fame in 2025.

items.question: How old is Cappie Pondexter?
items.answer: Cappie Pondexter was born January 7, 1983, in Oceanside, California.
